name: com.xlx.speech.voicereadsdk.ui.activity.mutual.SpeechVoiceSloganReadActivity
description: For a slogan-based voice ad, the Xinliangxiang Voice Read SDK shows the advertiser’s slogan and reward, plays spoken guidance, and prompts the user to read the slogan aloud to complete the task.
disableEffect: Blocking it prevents the slogan-reading reward step from running, so rewards for completing that ad will no longer be granted.
